name: Yoast SEO Premium
tagline: Yoast SEO Premium's solo core is compact: build a focused WordPress SEO plugin audit for user-owned sites that crawls pages, records technical signals, and exports a prioritized CSV and HTML report. A competent builder can reach a useful personal version in one sitting, while the paid product mainly wins on proprietary data, index, crawl scale.
verdictSummary: YES: Yoast SEO Premium costs $8.25/mo ($99/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
